summary:
Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch 1.12.1 and TensorFlow 2.9.1, and both spec examples return the expected image URIs. Changes are in src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json, src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/tensorflow.json and src/sagemaker/image_uris.py. Nothing was committed.

Verification: test_retrieve.py passed 24/24. test_fw_utils.py and test_pytorch.py gave 1010 passed and 12 failed. All 12 failures are the new 1.12.1 cases, because the test fixtures run every inference version on x86 instances and the guard rejects Graviton-only versions there. The TensorFlow 2.9.1 test selection did not run (5 collection errors). The venv lacks the `mock` package, so I used a shim at /tmp/mockshim outside the repo.

Blocked on your decision: either update the test fixtures to skip Graviton-only versions for x86 instances (a test change I did not make), or drop the guard, which I do not recommend because x86 users would get a Graviton image.
